title: VA Home Loan Guaranty Funding Fee Refund Share Available to a Home Loan Guaranty Debt by Repayment Method
content:
The share of the fee returned on a VA Home Loan Guaranty funding fee refund that may be applied against the veteran's home loan guaranty debt depends on how that debt is being repaid, as the repayment plan on the Home Loan Guaranty Debt in the veteran's Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery records shows it.

## Share by repayment method

| How the Home Loan Guaranty Debt is being repaid | Share of the fee returned that may be applied |
|---|---|
| Under a repayment plan by direct payment | 50 percent |
| Under a repayment plan by benefit withholding | 75 percent |
| Otherwise | The whole fee returned (100 percent) |

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Repayment plan method on the Home Loan Guaranty Debt | Hypothetical fee returned | Share | Fee returned times the share divided by one hundred |
|---|---|---|---|
| Direct payment | 2,400.00 | 50 | 1,200.00 |
| Benefit withholding | 2,400.00 | 75 | 1,800.00 |
| No repayment plan | 2,400.00 | 100 | 2,400.00 |

## Points of judgement

- Only a repayment plan's method selects 50 or 75 percent. A debt that is not under a repayment plan, whatever its balance, falls on the whole fee returned.
- The method is read from the repayment plan recorded on the debt, not from how the veteran describes paying.
